project.name: Hospital Management System
project.summary: A system for patient registration, appointment scheduling, medical record access, doctor workflow, and admin billing.

functional_requirements: Patients can register and maintain personal profiles.
Patients can book, modify, and cancel appointments with doctors.
Patients can view their medical history, including diagnoses and prescriptions.
Doctors can manage their appointment schedules and record diagnoses and prescriptions.
Administrators can manage departments, doctors, and patient billing.
non_functional_requirements: All patient data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.
System responses for user actions must be under 2 seconds.
The architecture should support scaling to handle peak hospital loads.

actors.name: Patient
actors.description: Uses the system to register, schedule appointments, and view personal medical records.

actors.name: Doctor
actors.description: Manages schedule, records diagnoses, and writes prescriptions for assigned patients.

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Oversees departments, doctor accounts, and handles patient billing and financial reports.

use_cases.name: Register Account
use_cases.description: Patient creates a new account with personal and contact information.

use_cases.name: Book Appointment
use_cases.description: Patient selects a doctor and available time slot to schedule an appointment.

use_cases.name: View Medical History
use_cases.description: Patient accesses a list of past visits, diagnoses, and prescriptions.

use_cases.name: Record Diagnosis and Prescription
use_cases.description: Doctor enters diagnosis details and writes a prescription for a patient after an appointment.

use_cases.name: Manage Billing
use_cases.description: Administrator generates invoices, records payments, and updates billing status for patients.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Patients can register and maintain personal profiles.
criteria: Registration completes within three steps.
A confirmation email is sent immediately after registration.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Patients can book, modify, and cancel appointments with doctors.
criteria: Appointment booking shows only available slots.
Confirmation and reminder notifications are sent to the patient.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Patients can view their medical history, including diagnoses and prescriptions.
criteria: Medical history loads within 2 seconds.
All records are displayed in chronological order with clear labels.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Doctors can manage their appointment schedules and record diagnoses and prescriptions.
criteria: Doctors can add, edit, or cancel appointments without errors.
Saved diagnoses and prescriptions are encrypted and retrievable by the patient.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Administrators can manage departments, doctors, and patient billing.
criteria: Billing reports can be generated for any date range.
Payment status updates reflect instantly in the patient’s account.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to register an account, so that I can access the hospital system securely.
acceptance_criteria: The registration form validates required fields and email format.
A confirmation email is sent and the account becomes active after verification.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to book appointments with doctors, so that I can receive timely care.
acceptance_criteria: Patients can view available time slots for selected doctors.
The system confirms the booking and sends a notification to the patient and doctor.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to view my medical history, so that I can stay informed about my health records.
acceptance_criteria: Medical history displays past appointments, diagnoses, and prescriptions.
Data is presented only after successful authentication.

user_stories.story: As a doctor, I want to manage my appointment schedule, so that I can organize my patient visits efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: Doctors can add, edit, or cancel time slots in their calendar.
Changes are reflected in real-time for patient booking availability.

user_stories.story: As a doctor, I want to record diagnoses and write prescriptions, so that patients receive appropriate treatment.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnoses and prescriptions are saved to the patient’s record instantly.
Prescriptions can be exported or sent electronically to the pharmacy.

user_stories.story: As an administrator, I want to manage departments, doctors, and patient billing, so that the hospital operates smoothly.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can add, update, or deactivate departments and doctor profiles.
Billing records are generated for completed appointments and can be reviewed or edited.

A doctor can have many appointments
An appointment can generate multiple prescriptions

Database Designer.sql:
CREATE TABLE Patients (
    patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    full_name TEXT,
    date_of_birth DATETIME,
    phone_number TEXT,
    address TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE Doctors (
    doctor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    full_name TEXT,
    specialty TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    is_active BOOLEAN
);

CREATE TABLE Appointments (
    appointment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    patient_id INTEGER,
    doctor_id INTEGER,
    appointment_time DATETIME,
    status TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES Patients(patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (doctor_id) REFERENCES Doctors(doctor_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Prescriptions (
    prescription_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    appointment_id INTEGER,
    diagnosis TEXT,
    medication TEXT,
    dosage TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES Appointments(appointment_id)
);

    end

        DB[PostgreSQL]
        Cache[Redis]
    end
    UI --> GW
    GW --> BE
    BE --> DB
    BE --> Cache
    style UI fill:#bbf,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px
    style BE fill:#bfb,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px
    style DB fill:#fbb,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px
    style Cache fill:#ffb,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px

Documentation.readme: Hospital Management System (HMS) enables patient registration, appointment booking, medical history viewing, doctor schedule management, diagnosis recording, prescription writing, and admin control of departments, staff, and billing. Built with a RESTful API, React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, and PostgreSQL database. Emphasizes data security, low latency, and 99.9% uptime.
Documentation.api_documentation: POST /patients – register; GET /patients/{id} – profile; GET /patients/{id}/history – medical history. POST /appointments – book; GET /doctors/{id}/schedule – view schedule; PUT /appointments/{id} – update status. POST /diagnoses – record; POST /prescriptions – create. Admin: GET/POST/PUT /departments, /doctors, /billing. All endpoints require JWT auth, role‑based access.
Documentation.installation: Clone repo, run `npm install` in server and client directories. Set up PostgreSQL, run `psql -f schema.sql`. Create .env with DB_URL, JWT_SECRET, and PORT. Run `npm run migrate`. Start server with `npm start` and client with `npm run dev`.
Documentation.deployment: Containerize with Docker; use docker-compose to launch app, db, and nginx reverse proxy. Deploy to AWS ECS or Azure App Service. Enable TLS via Let's Encrypt. Configure auto‑scaling and health checks. Use CloudWatch/Log Analytics for monitoring.
Documentation.sprint_plan: Sprint 1: Core patient registration & auth. Sprint 2: Appointment booking & doctor schedule UI. Sprint 3: Diagnosis, prescription APIs. Sprint 4: Admin module for departments, billing. Sprint 5: Security hardening, testing, CI/CD pipeline. Each sprint 2 weeks, with demo and retrospective.
Documentation.architecture: Three‑tier: React SPA (frontend) → Node.js/Express REST API (business logic) → PostgreSQL (data). JWT for stateless auth, role‑based middleware. Nginx as load balancer and SSL terminator. Docker containers for each tier, orchestrated by Docker Compose or Kubernetes for scalability and high availability.
